title: v1 of the site: mission-control look, live counters, workflow diagram
summary: We replaced the placeholder with a lab-notebook-meets-mission-control design: graph-paper grid, serif headlines, monospace readouts, light and dark themes. Headline counters and per-agent numbers are read from site/data at runtime, and the approved how-it-works copy is rendered as a step-by-step workflow diagram with a highlighted human control point on every step. Day-one data is nearly all zeros, so we made every section fall back to dashes or plain empty states rather than hide.

title: The repo is born
summary: We scaffolded the repository, the agent rules in CLAUDE.md, the roadmap and the GitHub Actions pipeline that lets AI agents plan, build, review and deploy this site. This placeholder page is the last thing a human-directed session will write here.
